name: pancake_replay_comment_lead
description: Safely replay a missed purchase comment lead via POST /api/admin/conversations/:id/replay-comment-lead (sends public comment ack + private inbox opener and records audit log). Requires confirmReplay=true.

target.description: Pancake comment conversation URL, Pancake ID (POSTID_COMMENTID), or local UUID

postId.description: Optional explicit Facebook post ID (PAGEID_POSTID) override

messageId.description: Optional explicit comment message ID override

confirmReplay.description: Must be set to true to authorize sending the comment lead reply
